effect_description_eng: [Main] [Once Per Turn] For the turn, 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s is also treated as a 3000 DP Digimon and can't digivolve.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your red or yellow Tamers becomes suspended, you may delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
